info.title: EGI Media AI Backend API
info.description: API contract for the EGI Media AI decision-support service. The service is tenant- and company-scoped, reads editorial articles from egi-media-backend, and exposes only validated AI projections. It never exposes prompts, provider credentials, raw provider output, or CMS write operations.

tags.name: Issues
tags.description: Company-scoped issue search, detail, and saved items

tags.name: Inbox
tags.description: Archived alert and digest email projections

tags.name: Reports
tags.description: Report read and human review commands

tags.name: Company Context
tags.description: Versioned Company Context and async draft requests

tags.name: Feedback
tags.description: Human feedback; no automatic learning in v0.1

get.description: Returns at most five active, validated issues for one authorized company. The Top 5 cap exists only in this projection; it is not a storage, search, report, or analysis cap.

Returns company-scoped issue projections. Results are not limited to Top 5. Only current validated data is returned; pending or failed stages are represented by safe pipeline state, not raw model output.
Returns the issue timeline, current validated analysis, priority, claims, and canonical article citations. The caller must be authorized for the requested company.

post.summary: Save an issue for the current user

delete.summary: Remove an issue from saved items

get.summary: List archived alert and digest emails
get.description: Returns the AI service archive of validated delivery intents and provider outcomes, scoped to the authorized user and company. It is not a direct mailbox provider API.

patch.summary: Mark an archived email as read
patch.description: Read state is a user interaction and does not alter alert eligibility, issue priority, or source truth.

post.summary: Submit a report for review or request changes

post.description: Human-only command. The model cannot approve a report. Exact approver role is product/security controlled.

post.summary: Create a report share delivery intent
post.description: External delivery command. It accepts only an approved current report, records an auditable intent, and may be held for human review. It never sends from unvalidated AI output.

202.description: Share intent accepted or queued for review

put.summary: Create a new Company Context version
put.description: Human edit becomes the effective source of truth. The command creates a new version and never overwrites prior context in place.

post.summary: Request an asynchronous Company Context draft
post.description: Starts T01. URL/file/manual text is untrusted. Backend validates source policy before a worker can call the model; the result is always a draft and never automatically effective.

get.summary: Get a Company Context draft for human review

patch.summary: Edit a Company Context draft before approval
patch.description: Human edits move an in-review draft back to draft. Approved drafts cannot be edited.

post.summary: Submit a Company Context draft for human review
Approve a reviewed Company Context draft
post.description: Only this human-approved action creates an effective Company Context version for downstream T02 use.

200.description: Draft approved and effective context version created

post.description: Stores advisory feedback against a scoped target. It does not automatically retrain, alter relevance, or mutate priority in v0.1.

post.summary: Start a scoped ingest or backfill run
post.description: Internal-only. Does not accept article content from callers. The worker reads CMS using the source contract and performs published/source validation before creating snapshots.

post.summary: Replay a selected pipeline stage from a recorded input version
post.description: Internal/operator-only. Replay creates a new run and never overwrites historical stage output in place. Scope, source version, and idempotency are revalidated.

bearerAuth.description: End-user identity. Tenant/company scope is derived and verified server-side.

internalServiceAuth.description: Internal service or authorized operator identity; never available to frontend.

CompanyIdQuery.name: company_id
CompanyIdQuery.description: Company context to read. Server verifies tenant membership.

CompanyIdHeader.name: X-Company-Id
CompanyIdHeader.description: Active company for a mutation. Server verifies tenant/company access.

IfMatchHeader.name: If-Match
IfMatchHeader.description: Current resource version for optimistic concurrency.

NotFound.description: Resource not found in caller scope

Conflict.description: Idempotency key, version, or state conflict

BusinessRuleError.description: Valid request cannot proceed because of pipeline/state/delivery business rules

failure_code.description: Safe classification only; no raw provider/internal error.

is_material.description: Null until product material-update rule is approved.
